chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Cursed, cursed is the one who neglects those under his care."

key_terms.ضَيَّعَ: neglected, failed to care for, or allowed to be lost
key_terms.مَلْعُونٌ: accursed; one who is condemned and deprived of divine mercy
key_terms.يَعُولُ: supports, maintains, and takes care of financially and practically

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about neglecting one's dependents?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns a person who neglects those for whom he is responsible. It emphasizes the moral seriousness of fulfilling one's duties toward dependents and preserving their rights and welfare.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4907 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Cursed, cursed is the one who neglects those under his care."
